latest.title: A new home for your data

updates.title: A new home for your data
updates.body: We’re excited to share that we’ve moved to a new database for your account, notes and files. Update the app to stay connected. If anything seems missing or isn’t working, please let us know through Feedback.

updates.title: Notes
updates.body: Keep photos, recordings and videos with your notes. Deleting a note also removes its attachments.

updates.title: Profile
updates.body: See your name, birthday, bio and email together, with editing and security options in the menu.

updates.title: Password recovery
updates.body: Clearer steps, a Copy password option and an easy return to the app.

updates.title: Flights
updates.body: Updates continue until 1:30 AM Jackson time, with more complete details for United flights operated by SkyWest.

updates.title: Settings
updates.body: Keep Arrivals and Departures on screen with one Always On setting. Press and hold supported settings for helpful animated previews.

updates.title: Flights
updates.body: Starred flights now move smoothly into Following. Expanded details are more compact, with departure and arrival information.

updates.title: Landed flights
updates.body: A brighter green Landed footer in light and dark mode. Newly landed flights stay in place for six seconds before moving to Arrived or hiding, depending on your settings.

updates.title: Arrival alerts
updates.body: Glass alerts stay visible until you swipe up, open Arrivals or receive the next landing alert. Your selected arrival sound now plays inside the app, and the flight card updates when the alert arrives.

updates.title: Appearance
updates.body: Cleanly rounded airline logos, better spacing for elapsed and remaining times, and a fully visible WebSearch button.

updates.title: Flights
updates.body: Redesigned compact cards with smaller city photos, clearer flight details and live progress. The same fresh design is now available in Live JAC Watch. Star a flight to keep it at the top.

updates.title: Search & filters
updates.body: Matching glass controls that smoothly expand and collapse, with a gentle elastic feel.

updates.title: Arrival alerts
updates.body: New liquid-glass notifications when a flight lands. Pull down for more details, swipe up to dismiss or tap to open Arrivals.

updates.title: Appearance
updates.body: A fresh, cleaner design that makes flight information easier to read at a glance.

updates.title: Home
updates.body: New glass droplet controls, a gentle fullscreen ripple and a clearer camera refresh pill. New animations when opening web links.

updates.title: Briefing
updates.body: A new magic refresh effect with a colourful glow.

updates.title: Flights
updates.body: More compact flight cards, matching loading placeholders and a redesigned Landed footer.

updates.title: Play
updates.body: Smooth two-finger expansion to fill the screen and improved fullscreen glass controls. Choose when the long control bar hides: 2, 4 or 6 seconds—or Never hide.
